status_definitions.Verified: At least two lawful real or de-identified export structures, plus schema-drift and end-to-end tests.

status_definitions.Generic Import: No dedicated adapter; imported through visible field mapping.
status_definitions.Not Tested: No actual export or exact official schema evidence.
